review_methods.maturity: Explicit project statements, releases and roadmaps considered; no promotion from a version, non-prerelease flag, stable channel or completed checklist alone.
review_methods.features: README overview/status and current description/limitation screening, plus selected supporting documents. Maintainer reports are not independent behavioral verification. Documents fetched but not read are marked explicitly.
review_methods.websites: HTTP, redirects, official-source linkage and page titles screened. No browser runtime or image-content verification. Per-entry url_checks reference the global URL results. Original failures and replacement successes are both retained.
review_methods.license: Project-level license identification; root license and relevant notices outrank metadata. Separate component/asset terms retained. No dependency-wide legal clearance.
review_methods.platforms: Documented builds are distinguished in listing limitations from tested or planned platforms; no independent installation qualification.
